blocks.content: The Constitution is not a mere lawyers' document, it is a vehicle of Life, and its spirit is always the spirit of Age.

rows: Inspired by US Constitution (Bill of Rights)

items: Frequently Asked: The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 added the terms 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.
Key Distinction: Fundamental Rights (Part III) are justiciable, whereas Directive Principles of State Policy (Part IV) are non-justiciable.
Direct Question: The Right to Property was deleted from the list of Fundamental Rights by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978, and made a legal right under Article 300A.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution.
The Constitution of India came into full effect on January 26, 1950, commemorated annually as Republic Day.
The original Constitution contained 395 Articles divided into 22 Parts and 8 Schedules, which has now expanded through amendments.
The Preamble declares India to be a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic.
